description: Erection of two 2- bedroom and two 3-bedroom semi detached houses
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the houses are occupied.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows [other than those expressly authorised by this permission] shall be constructed.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscaping have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Such details shall include, boundary treatment, parking layouts, vehicle access, separate pedestrian access and planting plans, and the scheme shall not be implemented otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.  The details so approved shall be implemented before first occupation of the properties or (in the case of planting ) in the first available planting season after completion of the development.

Condition : 7 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the four vehicular access points, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 8 - The garages and car parking accommodation shown on drawing PR1 Rev B shall be provided before the dwellings to which it relates are first occupied and thereafter shall not be used for any purpose other than for the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 9 - No development shall take place until full particulars and details of a sheme to insulate the houses against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 10 - Before the development hereby permitted commences on the site an investigation shall be carried out to identify the extent of contamination and the results provided to the Local Planning Authority.  The investigation will be carried out at such points and to such depth as the Local Planning Authority may stipulate.  A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority in writing and the scheme as approved shall be fully implemented and completed before any development hereby permitted is first occupied.

Condition : 11 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday and 08.00 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 12 - The proposed change of use would be compatible with this residential area. The proposal, and would not harm the street scene, or neighbours' living conditions, would provide acceptable living conditions, and would accord with the Council's traffic and parking standards. The proposal complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 New Development, E.1.5 Development involving Loss of or Changes in Employment Uses, H.1.1 Location of New Housing Development, H.4.1 Housing Standards and Guidelines, H 4.2 Residential Density, T.1.4 Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments and IMP.6.1 Planning Obligations of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan.
